header_sentences: See Jacob, and Most Ancient Church.

contexts.text: With their descendants... this arcanum perished.
Noah = the Church remaining with their descendants.
This posterity of the Most Ancient Church was not evil...
The third posterity of the Most Ancient Church. Treated of. (Compare AC 1123.)
This posterity of the Most Ancient Church was not as yet such.
This was the fourth posterity of the Most Ancient Church...
The dominant evil of this posterity was the love of self...
When men are such, the seed thence remains with their descendants...
(Hereditary evil) thus increases in the descending posterity.
(The doctrine) was preserved for the use of their posterity. Signified.
That those of the last posterity of the Most Ancient Church became extinct. Signified.
When the Church declined, as in their descendants...
In the last posterity... they apprehended nothing...
This worship... emanated to their descendants...
Seed, in the literal sense, = posterity...
The Angels do not perceive their posterity.
Such was the posterity of the Ancient Church when it began to perish.
The posterity of years () = the last time of the Church.
In the posterity of days ().
That (these things) might be revealed to posterity. Signified. AR 63.
We are of their posterity...
Thus it passes to posterity.
Thy posterity shall be consumed by fire () = that the remains thence will perish through earthly loves.
